limitations: Only explicitly catalogued native collision geometry is supported.
Default metadata categories and active models are conditional, not observed runtime state.
Intersecting unresolved modular variants block correction prediction.
Collision meshes use native collision hull vertices and indices, never visual meshes.
Mesh leaf hit-emission alternatives must agree; native compound traversal emits multiple child hits.
Dynamic animation, inactive model changes, runtime category changes, terrain and external objects are not inferred.
